operation: APK-first verified bundles; traverse every original GameObject, component and child in order. Decode MonoBehaviour fields with the selected official assemblies, including ECViewDriver SerializeReference registries that the native YAML exporter omits. Retain original pointers and raw object hashes without replacing or filtering components.
limits: Decoded prefab inputs only; native prefab conversion, component migration and production grid/status lifecycle are separate. These JSON inputs are not visible runtime substitutes.
